title.en: Firefighters battle wildfire as tens of thousands evacuated near Bordeaux
title.zh: 法国与“火焰旋风”搏斗，另有5.5万人撤离

summary.en: More than 340,000 people have now been evacuated from widespread wildfires across France and Spain, with firefighters battling intense blazes and "fire whirlwinds."
summary.zh: 法国和西班牙的森林大火已导致超过34万人撤离，消防员正在与猛烈的火势和“火焰旋风”搏斗。

body.en:
Firefighters are battling to contain wildfires burning near to the city of Bordeaux as tens of thousands of people have been evacuated from the surrounding region.

Speaking on Sunday, the city's Mayor, Thomas Cazenave, said the fire was about 15km (9 miles) from the outskirts of the city's wider region, and 25 to 30km (15 and 19 miles) from its centre, although downplayed the possibility of Bordeaux being evacuated.

Overnight into Sunday about 55,000 people were evacuated from villages to the south of the city in the Gironde region, famed for its vineyards.

Wildfires have raged across Europe over the past week, primarily France and Spain, where more than 330,000 people have been evacuated.

South-west France has been one of worst affected regions, with an area of 42,000 hectares burnt, making it one of the largest forest fires since World War Two. About 98,000 hectares have burnt across the country since the start of the year.

In total, more than 220,000 people have been evacuated in the south west of the country.

Captain Nicolas Braz, one of the leaders of the firefighting operation, said the fire had created "its own winds - complete with whirlwinds", adding it was "erratic and unmanageable".

France's Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said on Sunday the situation in the region remained "very unfavourable" and the wildfire was "moving erratically towards the Bordeaux metropolitan area".

In the Gironde region, the rescue effort involves 2,500 firefighters, including a Swiss team, 1,500 military personnel and almost 1,200 police and gendarmes, who are carrying out evacuations and helping with rescue and securing operations

Dry vegetation and brisk winds are causing the fire to spread, with 60km (37 miles) of the A63 motorway, which leads to Spain, having been closed.

On Sunday afternoon, Bordeaux Airport's departures and arrivals boards were showing delays to every flight from 17:15 onwards.

Some 28 Easyjet flights alone were delayed, many with no new departure or arrival time given, and five cancelled including UK flights.

Bordeaux Airport told BBC News air traffic control restrictions had been put in place "to facilitate the work of the emergency services" in fighting the fires, with all commercial flights affected.

The final stage of the Tour de France, taking place in Paris on Sunday, has been shortened from 133km to 89km (from 82 miles to 55) to allow security forces to be redeployed to the firefighting effort.

President Emmanuel Macron said France would "rebuild" and his government would "be there for as long as is needed".

Meanwhile in Spain, fires continue to spread, with more than 90,000 evacuated from the regions around Madrid and Ávila.

Overnight into Sunday, a new front also opened up near the coastal city of...
body.zh: 由于野火在全国范围内造成的破坏加剧，法国六个城镇又有 55,000 人被疏散。 最近的疏散行动发生在吉伦特省波尔多南部的城镇。 过去一周，野火在欧洲肆虐，主要是法国和西班牙，已有超过 33 万人被疏散。 法国受灾最严重，烧毁面积达42,000公顷，是第二次世界大战以来最大的森林火灾之一。自今年年初以来，全国各地已烧毁约 98,000 公顷土地。 消防行动领导者之一尼古拉斯·布拉兹上尉表示，大火“产生了自己的风，伴有旋风”，并补充说，火势“不稳定且难以控制”。 干燥的植被和强风导致火势蔓延，通往西班牙的 A63 高速公路 60 公里（37 英里）已被关闭。 法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯在《论坛报》周日发表的采访中表示，“需要很长时间才能得到控制”，在疫情得到控制之前，撤离的居民和游客“将无法返回”。 法国已动员军队协助应对，并派出额外增援部队帮助消防员清理灌木丛和开辟防火带。 总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙表示，法国将“重建”，他的政府将“只要需要就一直存在”。 与此同时，西班牙火势继续蔓延，马德里和阿维拉周边地区有超过 9 万人被疏散。 周六晚间，托莱多附近至少八个城市也被勒令撤离，但尚不清楚有多少人参与其中。 预计周日将出现高温和低湿度，可能使火势进一步蔓延。 马德里地区主席伊莎贝尔·迪亚斯·阿尤索将这种情况描述为“该地区历史上最严重的火灾”。 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯承认“未来的时期很复杂”。与此同时，巴伦西亚当局证实一名男子在火灾中死亡。

reflection.en: As wildfires force hundreds of thousands from their homes, the scale of natural disaster can feel overwhelming. In such moments of crisis and displacement, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a constant help in times of trouble. Even amidst the chaos and uncertainty, we can find solace in His unwavering presence and protection.
reflection.zh: 当森林大火迫使数十万人撤离家园时，自然灾害的规模可能令人感到难以承受。在这样的危机和流离失所的时刻，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱和不确定性中，我们也能在祂坚定不移的同在和保护中找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Water supply failure leaves Gatwick airport without working toilets
title.zh: 供水故障导致盖特威克机场厕所无法使用

summary.en: Airport’s bars and restaurants also unable to serve drinks to passengers because of lack of running water A water supply failure at Gatwick left passengers without access to working toilets or bars and restaurants. Passengers posted online that they were unable to get hot...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A water supply failure at Gatwick left passengers without access to working toilets or bars and restaurants.

Passengers posted online that they were unable to get hot drinks, wash their hands or fill up water bottles at the airport in Sussex.

The problem also had an impact in the wider Sussex and Kent area on Sunday, water suppliers said.

A statement from Gatwick said: “A water issue in the Horley area is causing disruption at the airport this morning. The problem is affecting water supply in both terminals and is currently under investigation.

“Bottled water is being made available to passengers and staff across the airport and other contingency measures are being put in place to ensure the welfare of our passengers. We will provide further updates and apologise for any inconvenience to passengers.”

Bottled water was being given to travellers at the airport and flights were not affected.

The utility company SES Water said there had been interruptions to water supplies in parts of the TN11, RH1, RH6 and RH10 postcode areas.

In its most recent statement at 2pm, the company said: “We are pleased to provide an update that our Bough Beech water treatment works are back up and running, we now need to treat the water before returning services to normal as quickly as we possibly can. We would like to thank customers and our partners at Gatwick airport for their continued patience, and we are sorry for the inconvenience this is causing. We will update you on the progress of the work as soon as we can.”

The TalkTV presenter Julia Hartley-Brewer posted on X: “If you’re on your way to Gatwick airport, it might be helpful to know that there is no running water across the entire airport. That means no coffees, no water fountains, no flushing toilets and no hand washing.”

On Facebook, one user posted: “Gasping for a drink & crossing my legs right now. This is ridiculous! Gatwick airport has shut all restaurants and most toilets due to a water outage. Not a great start to the holiday.”

The former MP and recently appointed government “music champion” Michael Dugher wrote on social media: “At least allow people to use the chairs in all the closed restaurants and bars. No water is one thing, but depriving people of somewhere to sit is another … Families are having to sit on the floor.”

Roger Wood, from Tunbridge Wells, Kent, arrived at Gatwick’s south terminal at about 11am on Sunday to fly to New York. He told reporters: “There was no communication. We arrived at 11ish and it had only started recently.

“We met friends at the bar but they couldn’t serve us as they were unable to wash their hands. I’ve never seen Wetherspoons empty. No idea when it’ll be resolved. The toilets also lacked water to wash hands.”
body.zh: 盖特威克机场供水故障导致乘客无法使用可用的厕所、酒吧和餐馆。 乘客们在网上发帖称，他们在苏塞克斯机场无法获得热饮、洗手或装水瓶。 供水商表示，该问题周日还对更广泛的苏塞克斯和肯特地区产生了影响。 盖特威克机场的一份声明称：“霍利地区的供水问题导致今天早上机场中断。该问题影响了两个航站楼的供水，目前正在调查中。” “整个机场正在向乘客和工作人员提供瓶装水，并正在采取其他应急措施以确保乘客的福祉。我们将提供进一步的更新，并对给乘客带来的任何不便表示歉意。” 机场正在向旅客提供瓶装水，航班没有受到影响。 公用事业公司SES Water表示，TN11、RH1、RH6和RH10邮政编码地区的部分地区供水中断。 该公司在下午 2 点的最新声明中表示：“我们很高兴提供最新消息，我们的 Bough Beech 水处理厂已恢复正常运行，我们现在需要在尽快恢复正常服务之前对水进行处理。我们要感谢盖特威克机场的乘客和合作伙伴的持续耐心，对于由此造成的不便，我们深表歉意。我们将尽快向您通报工作进展情况。” TalkTV 主持人朱莉娅·哈特利-布鲁尔 (Julia Hartley-Brewer) 在 X 上发帖称：“如果您正在前往盖特威克机场的路上，了解整个机场没有自来水可能会有所帮助。这意味着没有咖啡、没有饮水机、没有冲水马桶、也没有洗手。” 在 Facebook 上，一位用户发帖称：“现在正想喝一杯，交叉双腿。这太荒谬了！由于停水，盖特威克机场已关闭所有餐厅和大多数厕所。这对假期来说并不是一个好的开始。” 前议员、最近被任命为政府“音乐冠军”的迈克尔·杜格(Michael Dugher)在社交媒体上写道：“至少允许人们使用所有关闭的餐馆和酒吧的椅子。没有水是一回事，但剥夺人们坐下的地方则是另一回事……家人不得不坐在地板上。” 来自肯特郡坦布里奇韦尔斯的罗杰·伍德于周日上午 11 点左右抵达盖特威克机场南航站楼，准备飞往纽约。他告诉记者：“没有任何沟通。我们十一点左右到达，最近才开始。 “我们在酒吧遇到了朋友，但他们无法为我们服务，因为他们无法洗手。我从未见过 Wetherspoons 空着。不知道什么时候能解决。厕所也没有水洗手。”

body.en: Hunt ongoing for main suspect, named as Abdul Ballout, 21, after fatal attack in Tiergarten park close to LGBTQ+ event A deadly van ramming and knife rampage near Berlin’s Pride festival was an Islamist terrorist attack, German authorities have said, with a hunt ongoing to find the main suspect. One person was killed and 29 were injured after a man drove a minivan into a crowd of pedestrians, then stabbed people with what appeared to be a machete. The attack took place in the Tiergarten park near the Brandenburg Gate at around 10pm local time on Saturday, close to one of Europe’s biggest LGBTQ+ celebrations. Continue reading...

title.en: Joy in Greece as Mount Olympus joins Unesco list of world heritage sites
title.zh: 希腊奥林匹斯山被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，举国欢庆

summary.en: Mount Olympus, the mythical home of the ancient Greek gods, has been added to Unesco's list of world heritage sites after a 12-year wait, bringing joy to Greece.
summary.zh: 经过12年的等待，古希腊众神的神秘家园奥林匹斯山被联合国教科文组织列入世界遗产名录，为希腊带来了喜悦。

body.en: Mythical home of the ancient Greek gods designated alongside the D-day landing beaches in Normandy After a 12-year wait, Mount Olympus, the mythical home of the ancient Greek gods, has been inducted into a hall of more modern fame as Unesco announced it would be added to its world heritage list. Greece’s highest mountain made the list alongside the second world war D-day landing beaches in northern France and the ancient Japanese capitals of Asuka and Fujiwara. South Sudan’s Boma-Badingilo landscape, host to one of the world’s largest land mammal migrations, also won a designation – a first for the east African country. Continue reading...
body.zh: 诺曼底诺曼底诺曼底登陆海滩旁指定的古希腊诸神的神话故乡 经过 12 年的等待，奥林匹斯山这座古希腊诸神的神话故乡，随着联合国教科文组织宣布将被列入世界遗产名录，已进入更现代的名人殿堂。希腊最高的山峰与法国北部的第二次世界大战诺曼底登陆海滩以及日本古都飞鸟和藤原一起榜上有名。南苏丹的博马-巴丁基洛景观是世界上最大的陆地哺乳动物迁徙地之一，也赢得了这一称号——这是东非国家的首个称号。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The recognition of Mount Olympus as a world heritage site reminds us that the earth and its fullness belong to Yahweh. This designation celebrates the natural beauty and cultural significance of a place, reflecting a shared human desire to honor and preserve the wonders of creation. It invites us to appreciate the majesty of the world Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 奥林匹斯山被列为世界遗产地，提醒我们大地和其中所充满的都属于雅伟。这一称号颂扬了一个地方的自然美和文化意义，反映了人类共同的愿望，即尊重和保护受造物的奇迹。它邀请我们欣赏雅伟所创造世界的宏伟。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
title.zh: 关于柏林骄傲游行冲撞袭击事件，我们目前所知

summary.en: A police manhunt is underway in Berlin after a suspect drove a car into a crowd attending a Pride event on Saturday night. Officials are investigating the incident, which resulted in an unspecified number of casualties.
summary.zh: 周六晚间，一名嫌疑人在德国首都柏林的一场骄傲活动中驾车冲撞人群，警方正在展开追捕。官员们正在调查这起事件，该事件造成了数量不详的伤亡。

body.en:
One woman has been killed and at least 29 others injured after a van was driven into a crowd at a Berlin Pride event on Saturday night, in what officials say was likely an "Islamist terror attack".

Police have launched an intensive manhunt for the suspect in the German capital.

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has condemned the incident as a "heinous" attack.

The attack happened at about 22:00 local time (20:00 GMT). A report was made to police in Berlin that a white vehicle had been driven into crowds at a Pride event in the capital.

Hundreds of thousands of people had gathered at Tiergarten park, near the iconic Brandenburg Gate, for the annual event, which is known as Christopher Street Day.

Some people were also stabbed in the incident, with a blade officials believe could have been a machete.

A performance was abruptly brought to a end, with organisers taking to the stage and advising the crowd to start walking towards the exits.

As the message was being given to the crowd, the word "evacuation" was projected onto a large screen on the stage.

Unverified video posted to social media showed large crowds of people leaving the scene as emergency vehicles raced to the scene.

At about 01:00 local time, police confirmed that one woman had been killed and many more had suffered injuries.

A short time later, police confirmed they had found the vehicle believed to have been used in the attack, saying it had crashed into a tree.

At about 03:30, police said on X they had identified a suspect with Islamist links. No arrest has been made or motive suggested.

The search area was widened to the entire city and involved thousands of police, including officers from surrounding German states.

On Sunday, police officers stood guard outside an apartment block in Berlin's Tiergarten district, which is said to be the suspect's home.

The suspect has been named by police as 21-year-old Abdul Ballout, a German citizen of Lebanese background.

He was known to police and has committed a number of crimes, officials said. He had previously been sentenced to one year and 10 months in prison, but the sentence was commuted to parole.

German media outlets are reporting he is a supporter of Islamic State group (IS), and tried in the past - unsuccessfully - to join the organisation.

Police sources are quoted in German media as saying he travelled to Lebanon in 2025 and was arrested on his return to Berlin. Reports say he had been in pre-trial detention until May 2026 and had been ordered to take part in a de-radicalisation programme.

While his image has been released and a manhunt is under way, police have also said that one or more people may have fled the vehicle used, meaning there could be additional suspects.

title.en: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
title.zh: 巴勒斯坦人称以色列定居者在约旦河西岸焚烧清真寺、汽车和农田

summary.en: Israeli settlers reportedly set fire to mosques, cars, and agricultural land in the West Bank. These attacks follow a recent clash near the village of Tell, which resulted in the deaths of four Palestinians and two Israelis.
summary.zh: 据报道，以色列定居者在约旦河西岸焚烧了清真寺、汽车和农田。这些袭击发生在特尔村附近的一次冲突两天之后，该冲突导致四名巴勒斯坦人和两名以色列人死亡。

body.en:
Israeli settlers have set fire to two mosques, as well as cars and agricultural land in the occupied West Bank, Palestinian officials say, as tensions in the territory continue to flare.

The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tal, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.

The confrontation has further inflamed the situation in the West Bank, which has seen ever growing violence by extremist settlers against Palestinians, encouraged by far-right elements in the current Israeli government.

Palestinian reports say that two villages in the occupied West Bank came under attack from settlers overnight - with cars vandalised, property stolen and hate graffiti spray painted on walls.

The mayor of Qusra said that settlers set fire to a mosque that was under construction.

Abdul Azim Wadi said that settlers spray painted graffiti that included the word, "revenge", on the walls of the mosque.

The Israeli military has said that troops were sent to Qusra and that police would investigate and collect evidence.

Palestinian officials say that in a separate incident, settlers set fire to another mosque in the village of Kour and sprayed slogans on its walls.

Since the deadly clash on Friday in Tal, Palestinians say that there have been multiple settler attacks on villages across the West Bank.

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) has carried out raids and arrested dozens of Palestinians in what it's called a "counter-terrorism" operation.

The Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu responded to the incident in Tal by vowing to take "powerful action".

That includes the possible demolition of the homes of two of the Palestinians who were allegedly involved.

There's been a sharp increase in settler attacks in the West Bank in recent months.

It's drawn international condemnation, but has shown little or no sign of being reversed.

The situation had already deteriorated before the Hamas-led attacks on Israel on October 7, 2023.

But since the subsequent war waged by Israel against Hamas in Gaza erupted, settler violence in the West Bank has escalated.

The UN says 1,114 Palestinians have been killed in the West Bank, the vast majority by the IDF. It says at least 35 of the deaths have involved attacks by settlers.

It says 41 Israelis, including civilians and security personnel, have been killed in Palestinian attacks or during Israeli military operations in the West Bank since the start of the Gaza war.

body.zh: 巴勒斯坦官员表示，随着该地区紧张局势继续加剧，以色列定居者纵火焚烧了被占领西岸的两座清真寺以及汽车和农田。 两天前，定居者与巴勒斯坦人在塔尔村附近发生冲突，造成四名巴勒斯坦人和两名以色列人死亡。 这场对抗进一步加剧了西岸局势，在以色列现政府中的极右分子的怂恿下，极端主义定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为不断增加。 巴勒斯坦报道称，被占领的约旦河西岸的两个村庄一夜之间遭到定居者的袭击——汽车遭到破坏，财产被盗，墙壁上被喷上仇恨涂鸦。 库斯拉市长表示，定居者放火焚烧了一座正在建设的清真寺。 阿卜杜勒·阿齐姆·瓦迪说，定居者在清真寺的墙壁上喷上了包含“复仇”一词的涂鸦。 以色列军方表示，已向库斯拉派遣部队，警方将调查并收集证据。 巴勒斯坦官员表示，在另一起事件中，定居者放火焚烧了库尔村的另一座清真寺，并在其墙壁上喷洒标语。 自周五塔尔发生致命冲突以来，巴勒斯坦人表示，西岸村庄发生多起定居者袭击事件。 以色列国防军（IDF）进行了突袭并逮捕了数十名巴勒斯坦人，这被称为“反恐”行动。 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡对塔尔事件作出回应，誓言将采取“强有力的行动”。 其中包括可能拆除据称参与其中的两名巴勒斯坦人的房屋。 近几个月来，约旦河西岸的定居者袭击事件急剧增加。 它引起了国际社会的谴责，但几乎没有或没有任何被扭转的迹象。 在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击之前，局势就已经恶化。 但自从以色列随后在加沙对哈马斯发动战争爆发以来，约旦河西岸定居者的暴力行为不断升级。 联合国称，约旦河西岸有 1,114 名巴勒斯坦人被杀，其中绝大多数是以色列国防军杀害的。报告称，至少 35 人的死亡与定居者的袭击有关。 报告称，自加沙战争爆发以来，已有 41 名以色列人在巴勒斯坦袭击或以色列在约旦河西岸的军事行动中丧生，其中包括平民和安全人员。 自 1967 年中东战争期间占领约旦河西岸和东耶路撒冷以来，以色列已经建造了数百个定居点，容纳了 70 万犹太人。巴勒斯坦人和加沙地带都希望在这片土地上建立一个充满希望的未来国家。据估计，有 330 万巴勒斯坦人与他们生活在一起。这...

reflection.en: The cycle of violence described in this report, where one act of aggression leads to another, tragically illustrates the warning that those who live by the sword will perish by the sword. In moments of intense conflict, it is a profound challenge to resist the urge for retaliation and instead seek paths that break this destructive pattern. Yahweh calls us...
reflection.zh: 这份报道中描述的暴力循环，即一次侵略行为导致另一次，悲剧性地印证了“凡动刀的，必死在刀下”的警告。在激烈的冲突时刻，抵制报复的冲动，转而寻求打破这种破坏性模式的道路，是一个巨大的挑战。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，一条最终带来生命而非更多流血的道路。

title.en: Can Pakistan-administered Kashmir elections calm tensions?
title.zh: 巴控克什米尔选举能否平息紧张局势？

summary.en: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is preparing for elections following weeks of deadly protests. These demonstrations were sparked by disputes over parliamentary seats designated for individuals displaced from India-administered Kashmir, with one local faction advocating for an election boycott.
summary.zh: 巴控克什米尔地区在经历数周致命抗议后将举行选举。这些抗议活动源于对为印控克什米尔流离失所者保留的议会席位的争议，当地一个团体呼吁抵制此次选举。

body.en:
Pakistan-administered Kashmir heads to the polls after weeks of deadly protests over seats reserved for displaced people from India-administered Kashmir. One local group has called for the elections to be boycotted.

The first phase of local elections in Pakistan-administered Kashmir is scheduled for Monday, July 27, amid calls for a boycott from the recently outlawed Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), a grassroots alliance of civil society groups.

The JAAC has been demanding the abolition of 12 seats in the regional assembly reserved for people displaced from India-administered Kashmir and living in Pakistan. The group argues that only residents of Pakistan-administered Kashmir should be eligible to contest regional elections.

The dispute escalated after the Supreme Court of Pakistan-administered Kashmir ruled that the refugee seats are constitutionally protected and cannot be abolished without a constitutional amendment.

The regional government outlawed the JAAC in June under anti-terrorism laws, citing threats to public order, and detained dozens of its supporters.

The ban came amid rising tensions over the refugee seats and ahead of violent protests sparked by the group's campaign to scrap them.

The unrest has left around 30 people dead since June, according to local estimates cited by Reuters news agency.

India and Pakistan both claim Kashmir in its entirety, but each country only controls a section of the territory, making the Muslim-majority region a longstanding flash point between the nuclear-armed neighbors since their independence from Britain in 1947.

Since early June, Pakistan-administered Kashmir — known locally as Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) — has witnessed weeks of protests and sit-ins. While the dispute over the refugee seats has become a major issue, JAAC has also campaigned for broader economic and governance reforms. 

Following the unrest, authorities split polling into three phases, with voting in Mirpur set for July 27 and elections in the protest-hit Poonch division postponed until August 10.

Voting in the regional capital, Muzaffarabad, has been delayed until August 2 over security concerns. The JAAC continues to stage a sit-in in Rawalakot, near the Line of Control with India.

A major question is whether the elections can restore public confidence or merely offer a temporary pause in public anger.

"We are just asking for fair representation, which is our right," Ali Raza, a 22-year-old student protester in Rawalakot, told DW. "The local people who live here should have the right to choose their representatives, not the refugees who settled here from India."

"The election is a major opportunity for the people of AJK to choose their representatives," said Shazia Marri, the central information...
body.zh: 在为印控克什米尔流离失所者保留席位而发生数周致命抗议后，巴控克什米尔即将举行投票。一个当地团体呼吁抵制选举。 巴控克什米尔的第一阶段地方选举定于 7 月 27 日星期一举行，最近被取缔的查谟克​​什米尔联合人民行动委员会 (JAAC)（一个民间社会团体的草根联盟）呼吁抵制。 JAAC一直要求废除地区议会中为印控克什米尔流离失所者和居住在巴基斯坦的人保留的12个席位。该组织认为，只有巴控克什米尔的居民才有资格参加地区选举。 巴控克什米尔最高法院裁定难民席位受宪法保护，未经宪法修正案不得废除，争端升级。 6月，地方政府以公共秩序威胁为由，根据反恐法取缔了JAAC，并拘留了数十名其支持者。 这项禁令出台之际，围绕难民席位的紧张局势不断加剧，且该组织废除难民席位的运动引发了暴力抗议。 据路透社援引当地估计，自 6 月以来，骚乱已造成约 30 人死亡。 印度和巴基斯坦都声称对整个克什米尔拥有主权，但两国仅控制着该地区的一部分，这使得这个穆斯林占多数的地区自 1947 年脱离英国独立以来一直成为这两个拥有核武器的邻国之间的冲突点。 自六月初以来，巴控克什米尔——当地称为自由查谟和克什米尔（AJK）——见证了持续数周的抗议和静坐。虽然难民席位争议已成为一个主要问题，但 JAAC 还致力于进行更广泛的经济和治理改革。 骚乱发生后，当局将投票分为三个阶段，米尔布尔的投票定于 7 月 27 日进行，而遭受抗议活动的庞奇区的选举则推迟至 8 月 10 日。 出于安全考虑，地区首府穆扎法拉巴德的投票已推迟至 8 月 2 日。 JAAC 继续在印度控制线附近的拉瓦拉科特举行静坐。 一个主要问题是，选举能否恢复公众信心，或者只是暂时平息公众的愤怒。 “我们只是要求公平的代表权，这是我们的权利，”拉瓦拉科特的 22 岁学生抗议者阿里·拉扎 (Ali Raza) 告诉德国之声。 “居住在这里的当地人应该有权选择他们的代表，而不是从印度定居在这里的难民。” 中央新闻社沙齐亚·马里（Shazia Marri）表示：“这次选举是 AJK 人民选择代表的重大机会。”

Yahweh, through Christ, offers a vision where walls of hostility are broken down, making two groups one. This reminds us that true peace comes not just...
reflection.zh: 巴控克什米尔地区持续的紧张局势和抗议活动，凸显了社区之间可能出现的深刻分歧，尤其是在流离失所者的权利和代表权问题上。雅伟通过基督提供了一个愿景，即敌意的墙被拆毁，使两个群体合而为一。这提醒我们，真正的和平不仅来自政治进程，更来自一项神圣的工作，它能使疏远的内心和民族和解。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
title.zh: 苏丹内战：平民被用作‘人肉盾牌’

summary.en: The humanitarian situation in El Obeid, Sudan, is deteriorating, with reports of civilians being used as 'human shields' and children suffering trauma, unable to attend school. Rights organizations are warning of widespread atrocities.
summary.zh: 苏丹被围困城市埃尔奥贝德的人道主义局势日益恶化，人权组织警告可能发生大规模暴行。平民被用作‘人肉盾牌’，儿童遭受创伤，不敢上学。

body.en:
The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.

Flattened houses and rubble where a school once stood: These are the scenes that have appeared in footage of the Sudanese city of El Obeid published by Ayin Network, a nonpartisan Sudanese media outlet. Drone attacks by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have caused enormous damage to civilian infrastructure, including power grids, transformers, water treatment plants, schools, universities and hospitals in the capital of North Kordofan.

The local population is struggling to survive,  according to Ahmed Awad, project manager for the UK children's rights organization Plan International, and a native of El Obeid. The city — whose population previously numbered half a million but has now become home to several hundred thousand internally displaced persons (IDP) — is under siege, he added.

There is a shortage of medical supplies as well as food and safe, clean water, and Awad said he saw long queues of IDPs at just one water pump: "Sometimes you can spend all day to get one liter of water for two or three days."

He added that a drone had hit a primary school and killed three children, which had caused trauma among other children, many of whom no longer dared go to school.

"One of the mothers said three of her children cannot sleep because always they are in fear of something happening again," he said, adding that Plan International tried "to provide psychosocial support" for people scared of drones that could hit a classroom at any time.

El Obeid is a strategically important location. The city is a trading hub in the middle of the desert on the only major route between Sudan's capital, Khartoum — which is controlled by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) — and the western Darfur region, large parts of which are under the control of the RSF. Since the war began in 2023, the city has been captured by the RSF and recaptured by the army and allied militias many times.

El Obeid is currently controlled by the army, which has some 13,000 soldiers stationed there, and has been on the front line since fighting shifted from Darfur to Kordofan at the beginning of the year. The RSF has deployed troops to about 30 kilometers (18.6 miles) beyond the city limits, and has been using drones to bomb civilian infrastructure.

title.en: Brazil denies entry to senior Trump officials ahead of elections
title.zh: 巴西在选举前拒绝特朗普高级官员入境

summary.en: Brazil rejected visas for two planned US envoys, alleging that Washington was seeking to shape Brazil's upcoming presidential election. The development adds to a deepening political tension between Brazil and the US.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Brazil rejected visas for two planned US envoys, alleging that Washington was seeking to shape Brazil's upcoming presidential election. The development adds to a deepening political tension between Brazil and the US.

Brazil has denied visas to two officials from United States  President Donald Trump's administration who had sought to travel to the country to meet with electoral authorities ahead of the October presidential election .

A spokesperson for Brazil's foreign office said on Saturday that Assistant Secretary Riley M. Barnes from the ​US State Department's Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, had requested a visa on July 20, along with Samuel Samson, a deputy assistant secretary.

The Washington Post had first reported on the planned visit of the two envoys, citing senior Brazilian officials who said they had learnt of a US "ploy" that was "completely incompatible with Brazilian democracy."

The denial of the visas was ‌based on "evidence pointing to a renewed attempt to politically exploit the situation and undermine the electoral system", news agency Reuters quoted a Brazilian official as saying.

The US State Department said later on Saturday that Barnes and Samson planned to go to the South American country's capital, Brasilia from July 27 to 30 to discuss "election integrity," religious freedom and freedom of expression with government officials, religious leaders and others.

The Associated Press quoted the department as saying that the visit was routine and "any insinuation of a 'ploy' to undermine a democratic nation's election is a baseless lie."

President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is seeking reelection against Flavio Bolsonaro, son of Brazil's former President Jair Bolsonaro .

The right-wing Liberal party confirmed Flavio as their candidate for the presidential race on Saturday.

The senior Bolsonaro, Jair, is under house arrest as he serves a 27-year sentence for plotting a coup after his defeat to Lula in the 2022 election.

The former Brazilian leader had also presented unsubstantiated allegations that his country's electronic voting system was vulnerable to fraud.

Jair is a friend and ally of Trump and the Bolsonaro family has ties with the Trump administration.

In May, Flavio and his brother Eduardo had visited US officials in Washington, including Trump.

The Trump administration classified two of Brazil's largest drug-trafficking groups as foreign terrorist organizations, in a move opposed by Lula.

title.en: Israel rounds up Palestinians in West Bank village after 'shoot out' involving settlers

body.en:
Israeli forces arrested over a dozen Palestinians in the occupied West Bank on Saturday, after at least four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers were killed in a shootout when armed Israeli settlers approached a Palestinian village.

The circumstances of Friday's events remained unclear, but the clash in Tell has already had political repercussions, with Israel vowing to approve more settlements in the West Bank.

Israeli media reports and interviews with local Palestinian officials suggested a group of armed settlers entered Tell and were resisted by residents fearful of an attack. The Israeli military initially described the Israeli civilians involved in the incident as hikers, but later acknowledged some were armed and said both sides had opened fire before troops intervened.

Walid Zidan, head of the Tell village council, told Agence France-Presse (AFP) about 20 armed Israeli settlers from a nearby settlement entered the village and clashed with residents on Friday.

"The settlers were not following a route or trail, as they claim. They intended to attack the homes," Zidan said.

"People did not go there looking for a confrontation with them; they were simply defending their homes, nothing more and nothing less."

Palestinian health officials said Israeli soldiers shot and killed four Palestinians in Tell, while the Israeli military reported the deaths of two soldiers, one of them a settler in a local defence squad. Two other Israeli settlers and four more Palestinians were wounded.

Tell is part of the so-called Area A of the West Bank, where Palestinian authorities have administrative control and Israeli civilians are barred under Israeli law from entering. Area A comprises less than a fifth of the West Bank.

Zidan on Sunday said around 70 people from the village had been detained and questioned at a field interrogation centre set up in a house in the village. Around 10 to 12 had been released so far, he told Reuters by telephone.

"House raids are continuing, army patrols are driving through the streets, and there is no movement of people in the streets," he said.

"Every person who was brought in was assigned a number, which was written on their forehead," said Saif Hamza, who was released after questioning.

Over 80 Palestinians were arrested across the territory, said Amin Shuman, president of the Palestinian higher commission for the affairs of prisoners, calling them "an attempt to impose collective punitive measures and retaliatory policies" against Palestinian citizens after Friday’s events.

title.en: One dead and 15 injured after 'horrific act' at Berlin Pride event
title.zh: 柏林骄傲游行活动发生“可怕事件”，一人死亡，15人受伤

summary.en: One person was killed and 15 others were injured in a "horrific act" at a Berlin Pride event. Police later located the car believed to be involved, which had been abandoned.
summary.zh: 在柏林骄傲游行活动中发生了一起“可怕的事件”，造成一人死亡，另有15人受伤。警方表示，他们已找到涉事车辆，该车已被遗弃。

body.en:
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz vowed Sunday to punish the perpetrators of a car-ramming attack that killed one person and injured several others on the fringes of Berlin's Gay Pride parade.

At least one person has been killed, and around 15 wounded, police said on Saturday.

"We believe that a vehicle entered the Tiergarten park and hit several people and injured them," police posted on social media, later adding that they were hunting for the occupants of the car.

Merz said in a statement that he and Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt would "push to make sure this horrific act is fully investigated and punished".

The mayor of Berlin said "freedom has come under attack in the most horrific way".

Kai Wegner said in a post on X that the "gathering for a tolerant and peaceful Berlin has been most brutally attacked".

Police spokesman Florian Nath said some of the survivors were "seriously" injured and are being treated by emergency services.

Police told AFP they had found the car they thought had been involved in the incident abandoned.

The Gay Pride event was cut short, and police told participants to "Go home, please" and sealed off the area where the people were injured.

An eyewitness by the main Pride stage at Brandenburg Gate said the crowd complied with the request to leave and head away from the park shortly at around 11:00 pm.

An AFP journalist in the area saw at least 10 emergency service vehicles at the scene and a tent set up in the road.

Earlier Saturday, hundreds of thousands of people took part in the event, called Christopher Street Day in Germany.

The march ended next to the Brandenburg Gate, which has been the venue for concerts since Friday.

Germany has in recent years seen several violent attacks at public spaces, including a stabbing in February 2025 at Berlin's Holocaust memorial, a stone's throw from the scene of Saturday's incident.

title.en: 'We have done it': India's 'cockroach' movement notches up a major victory
title.zh: “我们做到了”：印度“蟑螂”运动取得重大胜利

summary.en: A significant protest movement in India has achieved a major success with the resignation of a minister, fulfilling one of the movement's primary demands after months of widespread demonstrations.
summary.zh: 印度一场声势浩大的抗议运动取得了重大胜利，一名部长辞职，满足了该运动数月来提出的一个主要诉求。

body.en:
Indian ‌education minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned, handing a major ‌victory to youth protesters nationwide who had demanded that he quit ‌to take responsibility for examination paper leaks.

The minister announced his resignation on Saturday just as police fired tear gas to scatter young protesters in New Delhi, hours before their leaders were set ‌to hold ‌another ⁠round of talks with ministers.

"Considering the situation that has arisen at Jantar Mantar and across the country, so that anti-national forces do not take advantage of this situation ... I have sent my resignation letter to the prime minister," Pradhan wrote in a ⁠post on X.

"I deeply respect the aspirations, ‌feelings, and legitimate expectations of the country's youth."

Cheers erupted among the thousands of protesters ‌who have been rallying in central Delhi and elsewhere as the news spread.

"We have done it," said Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janta Party that led the protests, to loud cheers at the Jantar Mantar protest site in New Delhi.

Youngsters at the site shouted "Jai Hind", a patriotic slogan meaning "Victory to India".

India's youth-led "cockroach" movement began in May after a supreme court chief justice compared some unemployed young people to "cockroaches" and "parasites" during a hearing on another issue.

In early June, a series of exam leaks that forced millions to retake a gruelling, high-stakes medical entrance exam sparked the movement's first offline protests.

The protests have continued since then, but anger boiled over after police on Monday injured dozens of students, launching baton charges ‌and firing tear gas to deter crowds of protesters marching on parliament.

Federal authorities on Saturday restricted access to the internet and to 18 metro stations to try to limit the protest in New Delhi.

In recent days, Indians in Australia have gathered in solidarity with those back home.

The protests also reflect anger over job scarcity, corruption and government accountability.

Despite rapid economic growth, millions of people in the world's most populous nation struggle to find stable and well-paying jobs, fuelling discontent.

According to a recent study, almost 40 per cent of India's graduates below the age of 25 are unemployed.

title.en: Vietnamese vessel sinks in South China Sea, 17 missing
title.zh: 越南船只在南海沉没，17人失踪

summary.en: A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.
summary.zh: 一艘载有62名船员的越南籍货船在南海永暑礁附近沉没，导致17人失踪。南海是世界上最重要且争议不断的海域之一。

body.en:
A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.

Rescuers were searching on Sunday for 17 people missing after a Vietnamese ship sank in the South China Sea , China's ⁠state media reported.

Authorities in the Chinese island province of Hainan said the cargo vessel Khoi ​Nguyen 18 ran into trouble near Yongshu Reef, also known as Fiery Cross Reef, state broadcaster CCTV said.

The ship was carrying 62 crew members, and 45 people were rescued from the water.

Vietnamese authorities arrived at the scene immediately after the cargo ship "sank while operating in bad weather conditions in the East Sea," Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Pham Thu Hang said in a statement to AFP news agency.

A Chinese rescue ship, the Nanhai Jiu 115, first spotted what was believed to be a distress flare from the vessel shortly before 6:30 pm on Saturday (1030 GMT).

The Khoi Nguyen 18 is a Vietnamese-registered ship measuring just under 70 meters (230 feet) in length, according to state news agency Xinhua.

It added that six Chinese vessels, a rescue helicopter and a Vietnamese vessel were involved in the search-and-rescue operations.

Hang said that authorities and fishing vessels were "actively searching for the remaining people."

Beijing claims sovereignty over almost the entire South China Sea, despite the 2016 international ruling, initiated by the Philippines against China, that its assertion has no legal basis.

One of the most highly contested areas is the ​ Spratly Islands , which China calls the Nansha Islands, where China has built runways ⁠and militarized artificial islands.

But ​Beijing's sweeping claims to the busy waterway overlap with those of other countries, including Vietnam, the Philippines, Brunei, Malaysia and Taiwan .

title.en: Typhoon Noul forces more than 715,000 from homes and cancels hundreds of flights in China and Hong Kong
title.zh: 台风“诺尔”迫使逾71.5万人撤离家园，中港数百航班取消

summary.en: Typhoon Noul, the strongest to hit China this year, made landfall over the weekend, bringing severe winds and heavy rain to southern China and Hong Kong. The storm forced over 715,000 people from their homes and led to hundreds of flight cancellations.
summary.zh: 今年迄今为止登陆中国的最强台风“诺尔”于周末登陆，给华南地区和香港带来了强风暴雨。这场风暴导致超过71.5万人被迫撤离家园，数百趟航班被取消。

body.en:
Typhoon Noul made landfall early Sunday bringing strong winds and heavy rain to southern China, including Hong Kong , over the weekend.

It prompted the evacuation of hundreds of thousands of people in Guangdong province with the region on high alert and hundreds of flights cancelled.

The typhoon – the strongest to make landfall in China so far this year – will dump heavy to torrential rains across much of southern China for two days, authorities said, after ⁠sweeping the province of ⁠Guangdong ​and neighbouring Hong Kong with gale-force winds.

The ⁠year’s 12th tropical cyclone and China’s third this month, Noul, which ​means the glow of sunrise ‌or sunset in Korean, struck ‌the coast of Huidong county about 3:50 am, officials ‌said.

It is expected to bring strong winds and heavy rain to nearby provinces such as Jiangxi and Hunan as it moves inland, state media said, with the rains likely to persist until Tuesday.

Extremely heavy to exceptional downpours are expected to lash some areas including the ‌province of Fujian, as the National Meteorological Centre forecast heavy to torrential rain from Sunday until Monday morning across ​much of China’s south.

Authorities urged local governments to pay special attention to flood-prone areas such as zones of mountains and rivers, building sites, valleys and bridges.

Hong Kong’s Observatory said Noul, with maximum sustained winds of 110 km/h (68 mph) near its centre, was moving Sunday into inland Guangdong and weakening progressively.

More than 715,000 people had been relocated for safety in Guangdong province, according to state media. Train services in the province were cancelled for Sunday, according to China News Service.

China’s National Meteorological Center expected parts of southern Guangdong and south-eastern Fujian provinces to experience heavy rain and strong winds. Many trees were seen uprooted in Huilai county, located on the coast of Guangdong province, state broadcaster CCTV reported.

Hong Kong’s airport authority said about 350 flights were cancelled Sunday. At least nine people were injured across the city during the typhoon period, according to authorities. Officials said flights will gradually begin resuming on Sunday afternoon.

As Noul approached Hong Kong, parts of a large scaffolding on a high-rise building collapsed on Saturday, police said, although initial reports indicated there were no injuries.

Taiwan’s Central Weather Administration said Noul was bringing rainfall to parts of southern and eastern Taiwan. It was passing over waters south of Taiwan, and was moving away from the island on Saturday.

Earlier this month, Typhoon Bavi brought strong winds and rain to eastern China, leading to the evacuation of more than 2 million people. It made landfall on 11 July. Another,...
body.zh: 台风诺尔周日早些时候登陆，周末给包括香港在内的中国南部地区带来强风和大雨。 这促使广东省数十万人撤离，该地区处于高度戒备状态，数百个航班被取消。 当局表示，这场台风是今年迄今为止在中国登陆的最强台风，在强风席卷广东省和邻近的香港后，将为中国南方大部分地区带来持续两天的强降雨。 官员称，今年第 12 个热带气旋、本月中国第 3 个热带气旋“努尔”（韩语的意思是日出或日落的光芒）于凌晨 3 点 50 分左右袭击了惠东县海岸。 官方媒体称，随着它向内陆移动，预计将给江西和湖南等附近省份带来强风和暴雨，降雨可能会持续到周二。 国家气象中心预计，从周日到周一上午，中国南方大部分地区将有大到暴雨，预计包括福建省在内的部分地区将出现特大到特大暴雨。 有关部门敦促地方政府特别关注山地河流、建筑工地、山谷和桥梁等洪水易发地区。 香港天文台表示，努尔中心附近的最大持续风速为每小时 110 公里（每小时 68 英里），周日正向广东内陆移动，并逐渐减弱。 据官方媒体报道，广东省已有超过 715,000 人被转移到安全地点。据中新社报道，周日该省的火车服务被取消。 中国国家气象中心预计，广东南部、福建东南部等地部分地区将有大雨、大风。据中央电视台报道，位于广东省沿海的惠来县，许多树木被连根拔起。 香港机场管理局表示，周日约有 350 架航班被取消。据当局称，台风期间全市至少有九人受伤。官员们表示，航班将于周日下午逐步恢复。 警方表示，当努尔接近香港时，一座高层建筑的大型脚手架的部分设施倒塌，不过初步报告显示无人受伤。 台湾中央气象局表示，努尔将为台湾南部和东部部分地区带来降雨。它当时正飞越台湾以南海域，并于周六远离台湾岛。 本月早些时候，台风“巴威”给中国东部带来强风暴雨，导致超过200万人疏散。它于7月11日登陆。其他，...

reflection.en: A powerful typhoon displacing hundreds of thousands reminds us of our vulnerability to natural forces. In such moments of crisis and uncertainty, we are invited to find our refuge and strength in Yahweh. Even when homes are threatened and plans disrupted, His presence remains a steadfast help.
reflection.zh: 强大的台风导致数十万人流离失所，这提醒我们人类在大自然力量面前的脆弱。在这样的危机和不确定时刻，我们被邀请在雅伟那里找到我们的避难所和力量。即使家园受到威胁，计划被打乱，祂的同在仍然是坚定的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: How Chinese tech and Russian tactics are aiding Iran’s bombing of US bases
title.zh: 中国科技和俄罗斯战术如何助力伊朗轰炸美军基地

summary.en: A report indicates that Iran's attacks on US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf are becoming more accurate and lethal, with assistance from Chinese technology and Russian tactics. This escalation is revealing vulnerabilities in existing defenses in the region.
summary.zh: 一份报告指出，伊朗对海湾地区美军基地和关键基础设施的袭击正变得越来越精准和致命，这得益于中国的技术和俄罗斯的战术。此次升级暴露了该地区现有防御的弱点。

body.en: Increasingly accurate and lethal attacks are revealing weaknesses in stretched defences across the Gulf As the crisis in the Middle East escalates, Iran has been bombing US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf with increasing accuracy, helped by Chinese satellite imagery and tactics learned by Russia in Ukraine. Three US soldiers were killed last Friday in an attack on the Muwaffaq Salti airbase in Jordan, which was being protected by a Thaad air defence system. Satellite imagery later released by Iranian media showed several buildings had been destroyed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 越来越准确和致命的袭击暴露了整个海湾地区紧张防御的弱点随着中东危机升级，在中国卫星图像和俄罗斯在乌克兰学到的战术的帮助下，伊朗一直在以越来越高的精度轰炸美国在海湾的基地和关键基础设施。上周五，约旦穆瓦法克萨尔蒂空军基地遭到萨德防空系统保护，三名美国士兵在袭击中丧生。伊朗媒体后来发布的卫星图像显示，多座建筑物被毁。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of escalating, more lethal attacks in the Gulf, aided by advanced technology, highlights the ongoing human tendency to refine the instruments of conflict. Isaiah's ancient vision of nations transforming weapons into tools for peace offers a profound contrast to the current reality of improving the means of war. It reminds us to long for a future...
reflection.zh: 海湾地区袭击升级，在先进技术辅助下变得更具杀伤力的消息，凸显了人类不断完善冲突工具的倾向。以赛亚书将武器转化为和平工具的古老愿景，与当前不断改进战争手段的现实形成了深刻对比。它提醒我们，要渴望一个将智慧用于建设而非毁灭的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Mass job cuts loom at VW as profits fall steeply on China sales slump
title.zh: 大众汽车因中国销量下滑利润锐减，面临大规模裁员

summary.en: Volkswagen has reported a significant drop in profits and reduced its revenue forecast, primarily due to a sales slump in China. The German carmaker is implementing a restructuring program that could lead to the elimination of 100,000 jobs globally.
summary.zh: 大众汽车公布利润大幅下滑并下调营收预期，主要原因是其在中国市场的销量锐减。这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项重组计划，可能导致全球裁员10万人。

body.en: Carmaker expects to sell 3% fewer vehicles this year as it pushes through a programme that could eliminate 100,000 roles Volkswagen has reported a steep fall in profits and cut its revenue forecast amid a sales slump in China, as the German carmaker pushes through a brutal cost-cutting programme that includes axeing up to 100,000 jobs. VW said it expects sales revenue to fall by up to 3% this year, a reversal of a previous forecast for a 3% increase on last year’s €321.9bn (£275.3bn), because of a sales slump in the highly competitive Chinese market. Continue reading...
body.zh: 汽车制造商预计今年的汽车销量将减少 3%，因为该公司正在推行一项可能裁减 10 万名员工的计划。大众汽车公司报告称，由于中国销量下滑，大众汽车公司利润大幅下滑，并下调了收入预期，因为这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项残酷的成本削减计划，其中包括裁员多达 10 万名。大众表示，由于竞争激烈的中国市场销量下滑，预计今年销售收入将下降 3%，与去年 3,219 亿欧元（2,753 亿英镑）相比增长 3% 的预测相反。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times of economic uncertainty and job insecurity, it's easy to feel that our worth is tied to our employment. This verse reminds us that all work, when done with diligence and integrity, can be an offering to Yahweh, giving it a deeper purpose beyond earthly outcomes. For those facing job loss, remembering this truth can be a source of dignity and hope,...
reflection.zh: 在经济不确定和就业不稳的时期，我们很容易觉得自己的价值与工作挂钩。这节经文提醒我们，所有工作，只要勤勉正直地去做，都可以是献给雅伟的供物，使其拥有超越世俗结果的更深层意义。对于那些面临失业的人来说，记住这个真理可以成为尊严和希望的源泉，因为他们知道自己的劳动具有永恒的价值。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Weather tracker: More than 900 wildfires rage across Canada
title.zh: 天气追踪：加拿大900多处野火肆虐

summary.en: More than 900 wildfires are currently burning across Canada, with many out of control in the Northwest Territories and Ontario. Recent hot, dry weather has contributed to the fires, which have already scorched approximately 3 million hectares.
summary.zh: 加拿大目前有超过900处野火正在燃烧，其中西北地区和安大略省的许多火势仍未得到控制。近期炎热干燥的天气助长了火势，已烧毁约300万公顷土地。

body.en: Fires remain out of control in Northwest Territories and Ontario, while Argentina endures record night-time heat Recent hot, dry weather in Canada has triggered hundreds of wildfires across the country. As of Wednesday, more than 900 were burning, scorching about 3m hectares of land. While fires have broken out in several provinces, the greatest concern is in the Northwest Territories and Ontario , where several remain out of control. Poor air quality has been reported across affected regions, with wildfire smoke carried by winds into the US and even across the Atlantic to northern Europe. The risk of further blazes remains high as North America enters the peak of fire season. Continue reading...
body.zh: 西北地区和安大略省的火灾仍处于失控状态，而阿根廷则经历了创纪录的夜间高温。加拿大最近炎热干燥的天气在全国引发了数百起野火。截至周三，已有 900 多个火点在燃烧，烧焦了约 300 万公顷的土地。虽然多个省份都爆发了火灾，但最令人担忧的是西北地区和安大略省，其中有几处火灾仍处于失控状态。据报道，受影响地区的空气质量很差，野火烟雾随风进入美国，甚至跨越大西洋到达北欧。随着北美进入火灾季节高峰，进一步发生火灾的风险仍然很高。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The widespread wildfires across Canada, consuming millions of hectares, remind us of creation's deep vulnerability and its 'groaning' under the weight of environmental distress. In these moments of ecological crisis, we are called to lament with the Earth and seek ways to care for the world Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 加拿大各地蔓延的野火吞噬了数百万公顷土地，这提醒我们受造界的脆弱，以及它在环境困境重压下的“叹息”。在这些生态危机时刻，我们受召与大地一同哀叹，并寻求方法来照管雅伟托付给我们的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

"A great degree [of its success] is due to the talent, infrastructure and the resources that were poured into building this...
body.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正在迅速缩小与美国同行的差距，引发了特朗普政府的新威胁。随着知识产权盗窃的指控，紧张局势会升级吗？ 似乎一眨眼的功夫，中国在顶级人工智能 (AI) 领域就从落后美国五年变为仅落后几个月。 尽管包括 Anthropic 的 Claude 和 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 在内的美国企业已经花费了数千亿美元来推动人工智能的前沿发展，但中国却走了一条截然不同的道路。 面对美国对帮助人工智能实现最先进思维的高端芯片的限制，中国科技公司优先考虑了数十种基于“足够好”技术的开源人工智能模型。 这些平台，包括 DeepSeek、阿里巴巴的 Qwen 和小米的 MiMo，现已广泛部署在中国企业、政府服务和消费设备中。 作为缩小差距的最新迹象，中国初创公司 Moonshot AI 上周推出了 Kimi K3，该模型在关键基准测试上可与最先进的人工智能模型之一——Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 相媲美。 在某些测试中，Kimi K3 可以与 Claude 相媲美甚至超过 Claude，但其计算能力却要低得多，而成本却只是 Claude 的一小部分。 全球技术专家 Alvin W. Graylin 认为 Kimi K3 的到来将高端人工智能从昂贵的奢侈品变成了实用且负担得起的东西。 “对于 98% 的客户来说，[知识] 1% 到 2% 的差异并不值得多付 10 到 20 倍的费用。” 中国的最新进展已经引起华盛顿的强烈反应，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普现在威胁要阻止美国使用中国的人工智能模型。 与此同时，财政部长斯科特·贝森特本周早些时候警告称，美国可能会因涉嫌盗窃知识产权而制裁中国模型。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 指责中国实验室使用他们的模型来训练他们自己的系统，这一过程被称为蒸馏。 虽然提炼是全球人工智能实验室在一定程度上的常见做法，但这些公司表示，他们的模型已经受到查询的轰炸，以收获高级推理。白宫四月份警告说，中国正在以“工业规模”这样做。 北京方面予以反击，否认这些指控毫无根据，并称美国威胁实施制裁和示范禁令是“技术欺凌”，旨在遏制中国的崛起。 华盛顿智库史汀生中心战略远见中心的研究分析师朱莉娅·尼赫（Giulia Neaher）淡化了提炼在基米进步中的作用。 “[其成功]很大程度上归功于为建设这个项目而投入的人才、基础设施和资源......

reflection.en: In a world of intense technological competition and rising international tensions, the call to live peaceably with all people becomes profoundly relevant. Even amidst accusations and threats, seeking paths to de-escalation and mutual respect is vital for global stability. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to pursue peace wherever possible, even when faced with...
reflection.zh: 在科技竞争激烈、国际关系日益紧张的世界中，与所有人和平相处的呼召变得至关重要。即使面对指控和威胁，寻求缓和局势和相互尊重的途径对全球稳定也至关重要。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们，即使面对竞争，也要尽可能追求和平。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Democratic lawmakers propose bank funded by China tariffs to boost US manufacturing
title.zh: 民主党议员提议设立由对华关税资助的银行以提振美国制造业

summary.en: Democratic lawmakers have proposed creating a bank, funded by tariffs on China, to provide grants, loans, and investments for US manufacturing. This initiative aims to revitalize the country's industrial heartlands and support smaller businesses.
summary.zh: 民主党议员提议设立一家由对华关税资助的银行，旨在为美国制造业提供拨款、贷款和投资。这项举措旨在振兴美国的工业腹地并支持小型企业。

body.en: Exclusive: Ro Khanna says ‘reindustrialization’ effort would provide grants, loans and investments to smaller businesses Democrats in the US Congress have laid out plans for what they say would be the “boldest” bid to revitalize the country’s industrial heartlands since the second world war – using revenue raised by tariffs on China. A bill introduced this week would create a new bank to strengthen domestic manufacturing, provided with up to $15bn in funds each year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：罗·卡纳表示，“再工业化”努力将为小型企业提供赠款、贷款和投资。美国国会的民主党人已经制定了计划，他们称这是自二战以来“最大胆”的振兴美国工业中心地带的计划——利用对中国征收关税获得的收入。本周提出的一项法案将创建一家新银行来加强国内制造业，每年提供高达 150 亿美元的资金。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As lawmakers propose strategies to boost national manufacturing and economic strength, it is a reminder that Yahweh is the one who gives us the ability to produce wealth. This divine provision calls us to steward our economic endeavors with wisdom and purpose, recognizing that true prosperity ultimately comes from Him.
reflection.zh: 当议员们提出振兴国家制造业和经济实力的策略时，这提醒我们，是雅伟赐予我们创造财富的能力。这种神圣的供应呼召我们以智慧和目标来管理我们的经济事业，认识到真正的繁荣最终来自祂。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: ‘A statement of freedom’: T-shirt slogan goes viral and book sales rocket in Taiwan after Hong Kong raids
title.zh: 香港突袭后，台湾“自由宣言”T恤走红，书籍销量飙升

summary.en: Taiwanese citizens express concern over the situation of independent booksellers in Hong Kong following recent arrests. A woman's defiant walk from a bookstore, wearing a T-shirt emblazoned with a "statement of freedom," has gone viral, leading to increased book sales in Taiwan.
summary.zh: 近几个月香港独立书商遭到一系列逮捕后，台湾民众对他们的命运表示担忧。一名女子昂首走出香港一家仅存的独立书店，她T恤上印着的“自由宣言”标语走红，导致台湾的书籍销量飙升。

body.en: Taiwanese people look on with concern at fate of Hong Kong’s independent booksellers, after series of arrests in recent months Walking out of one of Hong Kong’s last remaining independent bookstores, hands behind her back but head held high, the woman’s T-shirt was emblazoned with a simple slogan : “I am a bookstore employee”. Escorted by police, the woman was among five people arrested during raids on two bookstores last week , suspected of displaying and selling publications with “seditious” content, a national security crime which carries a maximum sentence of 10 years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾民众对香港独立书商的命运表示担忧，经历了近几个月的一系列逮捕事件后，这名女子背着手，昂首阔步地走出香港仅存的一家独立书店，她的T恤上印着一句简单的标语：“我是书店员工”。在警方的护送下，这名女子是上周在两家书店突击搜查中被捕的五人之一，涉嫌展示和销售含有“煽动性”内容的出版物，这是一项国家安全犯罪，最高可判处 10 年徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times when truth is suppressed, the simple act of seeking and expressing it can become a powerful statement of freedom. Yahweh's word reminds us that knowing the truth is intrinsically linked to liberation, offering hope even amidst challenging circumstances. title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test

summary.en: Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, expressing "strong concerns" and reiterating the importance of transparency following a recent ballistic missile test.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤与中国外长举行会晤，对近期弹道导弹试验表达了“强烈关切”，并重申了透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

body.en:
Kat Wong Sun 26 Jul 2026 11.00 EDT Last modified on Sun 26 Jul 2026 11.01 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Self-professed “data nerd” April Long was excited to fill in their first census after welcoming their son, Kai, to the world.

But as they opened the 2021 survey, they quickly realised it wasn’t made for them.

It excluded Long’s role as a parent, made assumptions about their gender and asked where Kai’s mother and father were born, when he has two mums.

Many “rainbow families” echoed similar experiences of the census being unable to fully capture the LGBTQ+ community.

“When my son started school, I wanted him to be able to grow up and know there are families like ours, and that we are part of the country’s story,” Long says.

“Just now, I dropped him off for the first day of term three, and I’m going to be able to tell him that.”

At the census on 11 August, Australians over the age of 16 will be asked to identify their sexual orientation and given separate questions on their sex at birth and gender for the first time.

The 2026 iteration also introduces non-gendered terms to questions on household and family relationships, among other changes.

“This is probably the most progressive census Australia has ever seen,” Australian National University demographer Dr Liz Allen says.

“Imagine being born into a body or orientation that you have absolutely no control over and yet you are forced to put yourself in a box you simply don’t fit in.

“This census is inclusive at the most fundamental core of who we are. It is saying that if you’re born intersex, if you are born beyond the gender prism of male and female, if you are in a heterosexual relationship but are queer – then you too can adequately reflect who you are.”

The Australian Bureau of Statistics explored adding topics on gender and sex to the census for years, especially in the years after Australians voted to legalise same-sex marriage in 2017.

Though it can make recommendations about potential changes, the final decision on census topics rests with the government.

At the time of the 2021 census, the Liberal party was in power and the assistant treasurer in charge of the survey, Michael Sukkar, had consistently said he planned to vote “no” on the same-sex marriage plebiscite.

But Labor’s victory at the 2022 election reinvigorated hope for change, and in September that year, Long and LGBTQ+ group Equality Australia lodged a complaint to the Australian Human Rights Commission .

They alleged the ABS had unlawfully discriminated against Long, their family and other members of their community by failing to properly count LGBTQ+ people in the 2021 census.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says his government is not planning to extend the fuel excise discount but has foreshadowed there will be further announcements on fuel in the coming days.

The 32 cents a litre fuel excise discount expired 30 June but was extended by another month at 16 cents a litre.

That discount is set to expire 2 August, at which point Australian drivers will no longer be shielded from price increases at the bowser.

Petrol and diesel prices have risen sharply in the past week. In Melbourne, unleaded rose six per cent to $1.80 per litre, while diesel rose 12 per cent to $2.17.

In Sydney, the average regular unleaded petrol price rose 10 cents per litre to 171.5 cents per litre and diesel fuel rose 22.0 cents per litre to 209.2 cents per litre, according to the NRMA.

Regionally, the NRMA said the average price of unleaded rose 5.7 cents per litre, while diesel went by 17.4 cents per litre.

The NRMA said it expected prices to rise further when the fuel excise discount comes to an end next Sunday, amidst rising wholesale costs.

Global oil prices soared this week, with Brent crude spiking above US$100 a barrel for the first time since May.

Albanese was asked on the ABC's Insiders program whether his government was considering a further extension of the excise discount.

"That's not in our planning at this point in time," the prime minister said, adding that the government would deal with cost of living issues "as they arise".

He said his government had set aside $10 billion dollars for a fuel security plan and hinted that more of this funding was going to be allocated.

"That [the fuel security plan] was about better fuel security going forward, including a government-owned reserve," he said.

"We'll have some more announcements about fuel in the coming days and weeks as well."

He would not say whether these "announcements" related to fuel supply or storage, saying Australians would have to wait for the details.

The statement comes as the ongoing war in the Middle East and the Houthi Rebel blockade of the Bab al-Mandab Strait continues to create chaos in global energy markets by restricting oil trade.

Around seven per cent of the world's oil output now transits through Bab al-Mandab, off the coast of Yemen. Experts say a blockade there could push prices into the US$120–150 per barrel range— creating further concern for domestic energy supplies.

Albanese said that figures released on Sunday showed fuel usage had "come down" since the US's strikes against Iran sparked a war in the Middle East and led to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz early this year.

title.en: AusAlert emergency warning test: What you need to know and how to prepare
title.zh: AusAlert紧急警报测试：你需要知道什么以及如何准备

summary.en: Almost everyone in Australia is expected to simultaneously receive this test warning on Monday.
summary.zh: 预计周一，澳大利亚几乎所有人将同时收到此次测试警报。

body.en:
Australia is preparing to roll out AusAlert, a new national emergency warning system designed to deliver faster, more reliable alerts during life-threatening events such as bushfires, floods and cyclones.

Australians will experience the system for the first time during a nationwide test on Monday afternoon.

Monday's test run will also help authorities identify any issues before the system is used in a real emergency.

Compatible devices will vibrate, sound a 10-second siren and display a full-screen notification.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The on-screen text message will clearly state that it's a test and that no action is required.

In the Australian Capital Territory, New South Wales, Queensland, Tasmania and Victoria, the test will happen at 2:00 pm AEST.

In South Australia, the Northern Territory and Broken Hill, the test will happen at 1:30 pm ACST.

It's just a test, so you don't need to prepare besides informing yourself of what's going to happen in those ten seconds.

The alert is designed to ensure warnings are not missed, but authorities have advised people who rely on concealed mobile phones for their safety to switch those devices off or place them in airplane mode before the test.

Drivers are also reminded not to handle their phones if an alert is received while on the road.

"You'll get a notification on your home screen that is much larger than you would normally see," Emergency Management Minister Kirsty McBain said.

"It will say: 'This is a test. We are testing AusAlert. You do not need to take any further action. You can get more information from the AusAlert website.'"

The AusAlert system, developed following recommendations from the Black Summer Royal Commission, uses cell broadcast technology to send location-based alerts directly to compatible mobile phones.

Unlike the current SMS-based system, it does not rely on a single mobile tower, making it more resilient if parts of the network are damaged or congested.

Minister McBain explained the technology, saying it uses a triangulation, or a modular square of towers.

"As long as it pings off any of those towers, you still receive your AusAlert notification."

The alert is designed to override silent mode and Do Not Disturb on compatible devices.

While that's intended to make sure warnings aren't missed, it also raises important safety considerations for some.

title.en: Joseph knows how to fight scams. This one almost got to him
title.zh: 约瑟知道如何打击诈骗。这一次他差点上当。

summary.en: An Australian man nearly lost $7,000 to a scam, prompting authorities to issue fresh warnings to taxpayers as the financial year ends.
summary.zh: 一名澳大利亚男子差点因诈骗损失7,000澳元，这促使当局在财年末向纳税人发出新的警告。

body.en:
The number appearing on his screen matched the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) contact he had saved on his phone.

The caller claimed he had outstanding tax debts, and offered him a discount if he paid immediately.

"I received a call ... they told me they had an opportunity. They had a discount for me to pay the tax office," he said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It wasn't until he reported the incident to police that he realised he had been targeted by scammers impersonating the ATO.

"The bank managed to locate the payment and returned it to me. It was around $7,000," he said.

Ironically, Sukkar works in cybersecurity, where he helps organisations identify and respond to online threats.

Fraud expert Dr Rachida Ouysse from the University of NSW said scams have become increasingly sophisticated.

"Scams are on the rise, and I think it's easy for anyone — like you or me — to get deceived because these scams have become so sophisticated," she said.

Many Australians are expecting communication from the ATO, are thinking about money, and may feel pressure to lodge their returns quickly.

She points to "nudge theory," or the idea that people are more likely to respond to prompts when they're already focused on completing a task.

"The thought that 'I need to file my tax return' is constantly on people's minds."

That makes taxpayers more vulnerable to messages that appear urgent or official.

Meanwhile, Australians lost $119 million to scams during the first four months of 2025, according to the National Fraud Investigation Centre.

CPA Australia says scammers frequently impersonate the ATO or registered tax agents through phone calls, emails and text messages to steal money or personal information.

"If something doesn't seem right, pause and verify the source," the organisation said.

It no longer sends text messages containing links, and it will never threaten someone with arrest over an unpaid tax debt.

It also won't ask people to pay using gift cards or cryptocurrency, or request their passwords.

If you're unsure whether a call, text or email is genuine, the ATO advises contacting it directly using the official ATO website, the ATO app or your registered tax agent.

While many Australians race to lodge their returns on 1 July, experts say waiting can actually be beneficial.

The ATO recommends many taxpayers wait until late July, when employers, banks and government agencies have usually finalised and pre-filled income information.

"The best time is when you have all the information available and no further data is expected that could improve your tax return."

title.en: 'It's not just hair': The fight to make curly hair education count
title.zh: “不只是头发”：争取让卷发教育受到重视

summary.en: A recognized gap in curly hair education has led many individuals to seek out stylists with specialized skills. The hairdressing industry is now actively working to address this need by improving training and resources.
summary.zh: 卷发教育的缺失导致许多人难以找到专业的发型师。现在，美发行业正在积极应对这一需求，通过改进培训和资源来解决这个问题。

body.en:

"Everyone had straight blonde hair. I remember going to school, getting water from the bubbler and flattening all my hair down because it was just too much," she tells SBS News.

Inheriting her curls from her Spanish father, Vazquez says her mother, who is of Malaysian heritage, didn't have the tools or knowledge to style and manage curly hair .

Now a mother herself, she has watched her nine-year-old daughter, Ivory, who also has curly hair, face the same challenges of standing out among her peers at school.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

She says she's determined to break the cycle and empower her daughter to feel confident about her appearance.

"I just have to embrace, educate and show her all the beautiful styles that are possible with curly hair."

For many Australians with curly, coily and afro-textured hair, finding a hairdresser with the right skills remains a challenge. Stylists say the problem starts in the classroom, where training has long failed to keep pace with the needs of textured hair.

Unlike straight hair, curly, coily, afro or textured hair has a different structure that requires specialised cutting techniques. Experienced stylists often cut textured hair while it is dry to better understand how the curls fall and frame the face.

Vazquez and her daughter travel nearly two hours to Curl Lab in Sydney, a salon specialising in curly hair cuts and education, but she says it took years of trial and error to find the right place.

"We went to one salon, and they straightened Ivory's hair and cut it. Unfortunately, her hair is never straight, so by the time we've gone home, showered, the curls bounced up and it was just chopped everywhere," she says.

Curl Lab owner Natasha Thandekafountas says the current hair education system teaches students the same cutting techniques for clients with both straight and textured or afro hair, rather than providing training tailored to different hair types.

"If you're cutting curly hair when it's straightened or wet, it's going to look good until the curls bounce up," Thandekafountas tells SBS News.

"We like to call it the 'Lord Farquaad' bob, so many clients come in for us to fix that," referring to the character from the film Shrek, who has a pageboy bob haircut.

The challenges faced by many people with curly and afro-textured hair are rooted in decades of beauty standards that experts say favoured straight hair.

title.en: The momentary slip that only showed Albanese's escalating control of the Labor Party
title.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯对工党掌控力不断增强的唯一一次短暂失控

summary.en: An escalator malfunction at Labor's national conference was noted as one of the rare instances where Prime Minister Albanese seemed to lose control over proceedings, highlighting his strong grip on the party.
summary.zh: 在工党全国大会上，一次自动扶梯故障被认为是阿尔巴尼斯总理罕见地失去对会议掌控的时刻之一，这凸显了他对该党强大的控制力。

body.en:
"We are proudly a progressive movement: two words that can't be applied to the escalator in this building," Anthony Albanese said to much mirth at Friday's Labor Party conference dinner.

The viral moment — in which the prime minister's descent came to a sudden, jolting stop, followed by an expletive-laden reaction — was one of the very few times this week that the veteran Labor party animal didn't appear to have a level of mastery over events that unfolded in Adelaide at Labor's once-a-term policy palooza.

"When it [the escalator] did come to a standstill, I'll admit there was a moment, just a moment, when the ladder of opportunity finally made sense," he said, riffing on former leader Mark Latham's ill-fated slogan from 2004, one of the party's more recent political low-points.

Two decades on, having achieved Labor's most powerful parliamentary majority in history, the prime minister said the party "can finally laugh about making him leader".

While the glow may have dimmed in the wider electorate, judging by recent polling, Albanese seemingly retained the halo of that 2025 election result among the delegates who 'debated' the party's platform this week.

The conference's myriad factions moved deftly to almost entirely avoid the passionate and public policy brawls of the past, which Albanese, the apex predator of the Labor left, used to once involve himself in.

All but one of the various amendments and motions was passed with unanimous support on the floor.

The sole outlier, a commitment for the government to remove barriers around using telehealth to access voluntary assisted dying (VAD), allowed a sole delegate to speak against the motion, the sole amendment to pass where some delegates voted against.

The party also enshrined in its constitution a conscience vote for MPs on this issue, similar to that allowed on abortion.

Trade Minister Don Farrell — a longtime Labor right power-broker who remains opposed to euthanasia — rejected suggestions debate was being suppressed among delegates.

"Far from a graveyard, this is a flowering of democracy," Farrell told the floor on Saturday to much applause.

Backbench MP Ed Husic had a far more pessimistic assessment, arguing that a perception has formed among Labor MPs that "taking a different stand or taking different ground presents a risk to the stability of government".
